rabbi-yitzchak-nappacha.name: Rabbi Yitzḥak Nappaḥa
rabbi-yitzchak-nappacha.bio: Amora of the Land of Israel, student of Rabbi Yoḥanan; his byname means “the smith.”
rabbi-yitzchak-nappacha.prompt: A sturdy scholar in his 50s with a full dark beard streaked with grey and a plain brown wool mantle over broad shoulders, a smith’s strong hands folded on a scroll; background of a Galilean stone courtyard with a forge glowing faintly in the distance.
